items.name: doodle-icon
items.title: Doodle Icon
items.description: DoodleIcon and BoilFilter: renders a hand-drawn icon, draws its strokes in, and keeps the line wiggling through one shared SVG filter.
items.docs: Mount <BoilFilter id="boil" /> once per page, then pass boilId="boil" to each icon. Add draw to trace it on.
